offence_note: First degree murder by youth sentenced as adult
sentence_quote: SB, MW, and TF were given life sentences with ten years’ parole ineligibility, pursuant to s. 745.1(b) of the Criminal Code
note: Adult sentence imposed on youth; appeal court re-sentenced and reached same outcome; EPSR given limited weight.

offence_note: Three incidents of sexual abuse of stepdaughter
sentence_quote: substitutes for the sentence that was imposed a sentence of 58 months less time served for a net sentence of 28 months, 23 days
note: Sentence reduced two months for harsh pre-sentence conditions; other orders not shown.

offence_note: Death threats, breach of probation, criminal harassment; dangerous offender designation
sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to a 54-month determinate sentence (less 51 months for time served). He also received a 10-year long-term supervision order
note: Conviction and sentence appeals dismissed; separate 3-year firearm attempt sentence already consumed.

offence_note: Manslaughter, aggravated assault, two assaults causing bodily harm in custody
sentence_quote: To summarize, I sentence you to seven years' imprisonment in respect of the offences of manslaughter and aggravated assault.
note: Nine months concurrent on each in-custody assault; additional day in lieu of surcharge; ICPM recommended.

sentence_quote: Finally, we cannot say that the sentence was unfit.
note: Brief endorsement; offences and sentence length not shown; appellant ordered to surrender to jail.

co_offenders: Quinn: life, no parole eligibility for 10 years
sentence_quote: I therefore sentence Forslund to life imprisonment with no possibility of parole for a period of 17 years.
note: No mitigating factors found for Forslund; Quinn had minor record and lesser role.

offence_note: Aggravated assault and break and enter with intent
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal only to that extent, and would not vary the global sentence of two years and eight months.
note: Concurrent aggravated assault term cut from one year to eight months; global sentence unchanged.

offence_note: Theft under $5,000 of truck; carrying concealed handgun
sentence_quote: However, I give Mr. Cromwell credit for two years less one day for the time that he has already served and impose a sentence of one-day imprisonment.
note: Mitigating: approached police and displayed weapon voluntarily; 10-year s. 109 prohibition.

offence_note: Manslaughter during home break-in of elderly man
co_offenders: Brandy Timmons: 3 years less 2 months time served
sentence_quote: on the charge of manslaughter, I sentence you to three and a half years of incarceration less two months for time served.
note: Conditional sentence found unavailable and inappropriate; 20-year and lifetime weapons prohibitions.
